metadata.description: Bring the Easter magic indoors with this fun audio egg hunt! Kids follow playful rhyming clues to find up to 20 eggs hidden around the house, with each clue read aloud and cheerful music in between. Grown-ups: check the transcript to see the list of 20 clue locations. If you can hide all 20 eggs, then you can use the Yoto link. If you can't, then download the MP3s and upload the egg locations that work for your family. As long as the intro is first and outro is last, you can do any egg locations

card.title: Easter Egg Hunt In Your House
